issues: Reveal animations gate content: drawer trays start at clip-path 100% and .rv plates at opacity 0. Anything the IntersectionObserver hasn't reached renders as huge blank voids: the story plate, quote and CTA are missing and the gallery drawer is an empty 1000px box on desktop, mobile and stress
Lazy-loaded category/gallery images never load below the fold, so mobile shows 4 of 6 category mounts empty
Every image-less specimen shows the same hatched 'FM'/'BB' blob. 24 identical placeholders make the catalog read as a broken template, not a collection

Sparse drawers break the ruled grid: 6 categories leave a dead empty cell at the end of the row; Birth Bear's 2 specimens sit in the left half of a 4-column board with a blank white expanse beside them
Mobile categories collapse to one column of 340px squares, a very long scroll of mostly empty mounts
Hero plate image is undersized for an 'oversized product shot'. The key annotations crowd it and the plate feels like a card, not a plate
Brand robustness: when --c-primary is golden (Fredimare) the label tab melts into the brass holder and the drawer number loses its frame
Strong points: the brass label holders, drawer pulls, numbered hairline key, dotted museum labels and a fully implemented lerp loupe (image 2.5x + cloned-text mode) are genuinely art-directed
fixed: Reveals are now animations triggered by the observer (keyframes with fill 'both') rather than a hidden default state, with a +12% pre-trigger root margin. Content is never invisible if the observer doesn't fire, and drawers still slide open with a pull-tug on the brass handle. Applied to both pages
After window load, all remaining lazy images are switched to eager so no drawer opens onto blank mounts

Missing specimens become 'Desiderata': a genus/species monogram built from the product name (Zeeuwse goudmerk → Zg, Caslon capital + italic Crimson lowercase), a foxed hatch tone and a mono 'DESIDERATUM' tag. Every cell is now distinct and on-concept (home + catalog)

Category compartments use auto-fit (no dead trailing cell). Drawers with ≤4 categories or ≤3 specimens centre their ruled cells as a fit-content row inside the dark tray, like a half-filled drawer, instead of leaving blank board
Mobile category min width lowered to 9rem → two-column compartments at 390px
Hero plate image enlarged (centre column 1.55fr → 2fr, 3fr without key) with more row air for the numbered key
Label tab gets an inner on-primary hairline and a dark separating edge so it reads as an inset label against brass for any brand colour
